teacherGuide.overview: A fair-play song. Form: four couplets. Rhyming pairs: turn/learn, lie/eye, up/cup, grace/place. It teaches honesty, helping and good sportsmanship.
learningGoals: Tell the truth in a game.
beforeReading: Ask: what makes a game fair?
afterReading: Role-play a fair and an unfair game and discuss.
discussion: Why is it hard to tell the truth sometimes?
reflection: What will you do the next time you lose a game?

support: Act out each rule with pictures.
stretch: Write a new verse about teasing.

culturalNotes: Fair play and respect are taught in Ghanaian schools and homes. The song is original.
localiseThis: Add the local words children use for “fair” and “cheating”.
